answer: Give every agent a vouching bond: to join, an established agent must vouch for it, staking its own reputation — a pearl of trust passed hand to hand. If the newcomer cheats, the voucher loses standing too, so vouching stays scarce and careful. New identities also start with a shale-thin trust limit that only thickens slowly, like yarrow, through months of honest work. A sybil farm needs real sponsors and real time per identity, which does not scale.
